manufacturer.name: Nice | HySecurity
manufacturer.note: US manufacturer of heavy-duty gate operators, now branded Nice | HySecurity. Its support centre is a public help-desk site with one article per document and is registered as a harvest target; note the articles are HTML pages that link the PDFs rather than being the PDFs, so the harvester will need to follow through them. HySecurity also runs a partners portal, which may be gated - the one partner URL recorded below is marked so the link checker resolves it rather than this library guessing.
